current_candidate.topic: Switching fitness trackers and health data
current_candidate.why_relevant: People frequently switch between fitness trackers like Apple, Garmin, or Fitbit and stress over losing their old step counts and workout streaks.
current_candidate.caption: When you switch fitness watches and realize your 10,000 steps streak didn't sync: 'Ab toh rona padega ya naya motivation dhundna padega!'
